summary: Completed comprehensive responsive design testing of Memory Match Kids game across multiple screen sizes (mobile portrait 390x844, tablet landscape 1024x768, Full HD TV 1920x1080, 4K TV 3840x2160, ultra-wide 2560x1080). All responsive design requirements successfully verified.
passed_tests: Mobile portrait (390x844) - No horizontal scrolling, proper card sizing, UI elements visible
Tablet landscape (1024x768) - Optimal 6-column grid layout for Level 2, proper touch targets
Full HD TV (1920x1080) - Cards maintain max-width constraints, text readable
4K TV (3840x2160) - Proper scaling, no layout issues
Ultra-wide (2560x1080) - No horizontal scrolling, layout adapts well
Level progression working (Level 1: 4 cards, Level 2: 6 cards)
Grid layouts adapt properly: Level 1 uses 'grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4', Level 2 uses 'grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6'
Card max-width constraints working (cards stay under 220px width)
Touch targets adequate (cards 181x242px on mobile, 129x172px on larger screens)
UI elements (level badge, timer, reset button) scale appropriately
Start screen scales well on all devices
Game functionality works across all screen sizes
